ntp_servers.description: List of NTP servers to use for fallback time synchronization when GPS is unavailable

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the NTP server

allow_ntp_clients.description: Allow NTP clients to synchronize from this server

allow_ntp_clients_subnet.description: Subnet from which to allow NTP client queries (ignored unless allow_ntp_clients is true)

enable_hwtimestamp.description: Enable hardware timestamping for improved precision (requires hardware support)

log_dir.description: Directory where chronyd writes its log files

max_log_age_hours.description: Maximum age (in hours) of log entries before rotation

init_stepslew_threshold.description: Threshold (in seconds) above which the clock is stepped initially (not slewing)

init_stepslew_servers.description: List of servers to query during initial step-slew (before GPS takes over)

rti_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between rate estimates used for smoothing time adjustments

makestep_threshold.description: Maximum offset (in seconds) above which the clock is stepped instead of slewing during normal operation

max_steps.description: Maximum number of steps allowed in makestep mode before switching to slewing

keyfile_path.description: Path to the file containing NTP authentication keys

command_key.description: Key number used for authenticating chronyc commands

command_port.description: Port on which chronyd listens for chronyc commands

drift_file_path.description: Path to the file recording the system clock's drift rate

rtc_file_path.description: Path to the file recording the RTC calibration parameters

leap_seconds_tz.description: Time zone to use when interpreting leap second events
